gloss: club; hobby group; association of enthusiasts

definitions.gloss: club; hobby group; association of like-minded people
definitions.explanation: An informal group or club of people who share a common interest or hobby. Less formal than an official organization but more structured than a casual gathering.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧{同好会|どうこうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧{同好会|どうこうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}っている→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
examples.english: I climb a mountain every month with the company's hiking club.

examples.japanese: {退職後|たいしょくご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{絵画|かいが}→絵画：02597_kaiga⟧{同好会|どうこうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}げて→立ち上げる：07892_tachiageru⟧、⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After retirement, I started a painting club and socialize with others who share the same hobby.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in companies, schools, and community centers. Less formal than ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (department/official club) or ⟦{協会|きょうかい}→協会：11831_kyoukai⟧ (association). Often formed around hobbies like sports, arts, or cultural activities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同好会|どうこうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to form a club)
- {同好会|どうこうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to join a club)
- 〇〇{同好会|どうこうかい} (〇〇 club)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧: school club activity — more formal and structured, typically at schools
- ⟦サークル→サークル：10933_saakuru⟧: circle — a casual group, especially at universities
